✦ RESONANT ARCANA — 1.1.1 ✦

Keep your target in sight. Put a little more power into every pose.

Minecraft 1.21.1 · NeoForge · Java 21

This update brings clearer first-person aiming and casting animations that match the spell in your hands.

🎯 A clearer view of the fight

  • Nearby Resonant Arcana particles now leave space around the first-person crosshair, making spells such as Tempest Spear easier to aim.
  • The clearance also covers server-sent lightning, particles that drift into your view and decorative spell outlines.
  • Distant effects and third-person spell visuals keep their full presentation.
  • Added clearFirstPersonAim, an enabled-by-default client setting. Turn it off to restore the full first-person particle display.

✨ Casting poses with purpose

  • Tempest Spear: raise an arm while charging, then follow through with a throwing animation.
  • Beam spells: charge with both hands forward and finish with a matching release pose that ends correctly.
  • Updated casting poses for storms, breath attacks, wards, healing, ground eruptions and melee arts, including optional cave and boss spells.

📦 Updating

Update both the client and server to 1.1.1. Requires Iron’s Spells ’n Spellbooks for Minecraft 1.21.1.
